active_threshold.description:
The number or percentage of tokens that must be staked
for the DAO to be active

token_info.description: New or existing native token to use for voting power.

unstaking_duration.description: How long until the tokens become liquid again

existing.description:
Uses an existing Token Factory token and creates a new issuer contract.
Full setup, such as transferring ownership or setting up MsgSetBeforeSendHook,
must be done manually.

factory.description:
Uses a factory contract that must return the denom, optionally a Token Contract address.
The binary must serialize to a `WasmMsg::Execute` message.
Validation happens in the factory contract itself, so be sure to use a
trusted factory contract.

new.description:
Creates a new Token Factory token via the issue contract with the DAO automatically
setup as admin and owner.

initial_balances.description: The initial balances to set for the token, cannot be empty.

initial_dao_balance.description: Optional balance to mint for the DAO.

metadata.description: Optional metadata for the token, this can additionally be set later.

subdenom.description:
The subdenom of the token to create, will also be used as an alias for
the denom. The Token Factory denom will have the format of
`factory/{contract_address}/{subdenom}` (typical),
`x/{contract_address}/{subdenom}` (Thorchain), or whatever the chain
uses.

token_issuer_code_id.description: The code id of the cw-tokenfactory-issuer contract

token_issuer_salt.description:
Optionally instantiate the cw-tokenfactory-issuer contract with
instantiate2 using this salt.

definitions.name: cosmwasm_std_binary_Binary
definitions.description:
Binary is a wrapper around Vec<u8> to add base64 de/serialization
with serde. It also adds some helper methods to help encode inline.

This is only needed as serde-json-{core,wasm} has a horrible encoding for Vec<u8>.
See also <https://github.com/CosmWasm/cosmwasm/blob/main/docs/MESSAGE_TYPES.md>.

additional_denom_units.description:
Used define additional units of the token (e.g. "tiger")
These must have an exponent larger than 0.

display.description: The unit commonly used in communication (e.g. "cat")

name.description: The name of the token (e.g. "Cat Coin")

symbol.description: The ticker symbol of the token (e.g. "CAT")

definitions.name: cosmwasm_std_metadata_DenomUnit
definitions.description: Replicates the cosmos-sdk bank module DenomUnit type

definitions.name: cosmwasm_std_math_uint256_Uint256
cw_utils_expiration_Duration
definitions.description:
Duration is a delta of time. You can add it to a BlockInfo or Expiration to
move that further in the future. Note that an height-based Duration and
a time-based Expiration cannot be combined

definitions.name: dao_voting_threshold_ActiveThreshold
definitions.description:
The threshold of tokens that must be staked in order for this
voting module to be active. If this is not reached, this module
will response to `is_active` queries with false and proposal
modules which respect active thresholds will not allow the
creation of proposals.

absolute_count.description:
The absolute number of tokens that must be staked for the
module to be active.

percentage.description:
The percentage of tokens that must be staked for the module to
be active. Computed as `staked / total_supply`.

definitions.name: cosmwasm_std_math_decimal256_Decimal256
definitions.description:
A fixed-point decimal value with 18 fractional digits, i.e. Decimal256(1_000_000_000_000_000_000) == 1.0

The greatest possible value that can be represented is 115792089237316195423570985008687907853269984665640564039457.584007913129639935 = (2^256 - 1) / 10^18
